Script.name: mmapper
Script.script:
if _G.mm_loader_in_progress then return end _G.mm_loader_in_progress = true
local home = getMudletHomeDir() local expectedFolder = home .. "/mmapper" local initPath = expectedFolder .. "/mm_init.lua" local requiredFiles = { "mm_init.lua", "mm_core.lua", "mm_area_references.lua", "mm_navigation.lua", "mm_portal_usage.lua", "mm_frontier.lua", "mm_bookmarks.lua", "mm_bookmark_window.lua", "mm_help.lua", "mm_minimap.lua", "mm_explore.lua", "mm_explore_window.lua", "mm_commands.lua", "mm_import.lua", "mm_gmcp.lua", }
local function file_exists(path) local file = io.open(path, "rb") if not file then return false end file:close() return true end
local missing = {} for _, filename in ipairs(requiredFiles) do if not file_exists(expectedFolder .. "/" .. filename) then table.insert(missing, filename) end end
if #missing > 0 then if not _G.mm_install_warning_shown then cecho("<orange_red>[MMAPPER INSTALLATION WARNING]<reset> MMapper was not loaded.\n") cecho("<yellow>Required folder name:<reset> mmapper\n") cecho("<yellow>Required folder location:<reset> " .. expectedFolder .. "\n") cecho("<yellow>Missing required files:<reset> " .. table.concat(missing, ", ") .. "\n") cecho("Move the complete addon folder into the active profile and name it exactly <cyan>mmapper<reset> (not <red>mapper<reset>).\n") cecho("No MMapper modules were loaded. Reload the profile after correcting the installation.\n") _G.mm_install_warning_shown = true end _G.mm_loader_in_progress = false return end
_G.mm_install_warning_shown = nil mm = mm or {} mm.base_dir = expectedFolder
local ok, err = pcall(dofile, initPath) _G.mm_loader_in_progress = false
if not ok then cecho("<orange_red>[MMAPPER ERROR]<reset> Failed to load " .. initPath .. ": " .. tostring(err) .. "\n") end
